title: A Negative-Control Protocol for Clinical EEG Foundation-Model Benchmarks: Dataset Identity and External-Cohort Stress Testing
abstract: arXiv:2607.24519v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: EEG foundation-model gains may depend on cohort, montage, or probe design. We evaluated five models on five tasks across four benchmark datasets plus Korean CAUEEG, using subject-disjoint validation where identifiers exist. CAUEEG is recording-level with an annotated no-overlap held-out sensitivity. On matched CAUEEG normal/mild cognitive impairment/dementia classification (1,187 recordings), classical features reached 0.734 macro-AUROC (enhanced sensitivity: 0.736), versus BIOT-bipolar16 0.677, CBraMod 0.669, and REVE 0.568. The annotated no-overlap held-out subset preserved the classical-over-REVE ordering (0.717 versus 0.565). All five encoders decoded dataset identity at 1.000 before and after in-fold PCA-50; label permutations collapsed to chance and balanced subsamples remained at 1.000. translated_title: 临床脑电图基础模型基准测试的阴性对照方案：数据集身份识别与外部队列压力测试
translated_abstract: 摘要：脑电图基础模型的性能提升可能依赖于队列、导联配置或探针设计。我们在四个基准数据集以及韩国CAUEEG数据集上，对五个模型在五个任务中进行了评估，并在存在标识符的情况下使用受试者不重叠验证。CAUEEG是记录级别的，并带有标注的无重叠保留敏感性。在匹配的CAUEEG正常/轻度认知障碍/痴呆分类任务（1,187条记录）中，经典特征达到0.734的宏AUROC（增强敏感性：0.736），而BIOT-bipolar16为0.677，CBraMod为0.669，REVE为0.568。标注的无重叠保留子集保持了经典方法优于REVE的顺序（0.717对比0.565）。所有五个编码器在折内PCA-50之前和之后均以1.000解码数据集身份；标签置换后降至随机水平，而平衡子样本仍保持1.000。这确立了数据集成员身份，而非因果位点、地理或人群效应。一个匹配的完全随机初始化的编码器...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种阴性对照协议，证明脑电图基础模型的性能提升可能源于数据集身份识别而非实际泛化能力，并通过外部队列压力测试验证了这一现象。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a negative-control protocol demonstrating that EEG foundation-model performance gains may stem from dataset identity rather than true generalization, validated via external-cohort stress testing.
